cues: Cribrum means sieve: the sieve tubes are outside.
Amphivasal is the exact reverse, xylem outside, and that is the trap.
Bicollateral has phloem on two sides only, not all round.
text: Amphicribral. Cribrum means sieve: the sieve tubes are outside. Amphivasal is the exact reverse, xylem outside, and that is the trap. Bicollateral has phloem on two sides only, not all round.
